laws.rule: Horton Plains National Park: foreign adults USD 25 for a day visit (about A$35.51, RBA rate of 30 October 2026) or USD 50 overnight, children USD 15 or USD 30, under the gazetted fee schedule; service charges, vehicle fees and VAT are extra.

sites.name: Sigiriya Rock Fortress
sites.what: Rock citadel with frescoes and water gardens in Matale District (UNESCO World Heritage).

access.tickets: Foreign full ticket USD 35 (about AUD 50, RBA rate 30 October 2026), half ticket USD 20, priced in US dollars and paid in rupees at the Fund's daily rate; SAARC citizens 50% off. Single entry; online booking through the CCF e-ticket system.

lore.text: Popular theories claim the Lion Rock was the palace of the demon king Ravana from the Ramayana.
